lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured array of high-luminance circular clusters is visible posterior to the gill slits, forming a grid-like pattern where spots are roughly equidistant in the mid-flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal ridges to form a matrix, with larger luminance maxima located at the intersection nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel horizontal ridges exhibit a sharp vertical gradient, with light reflecting off the dorsal edge and deep shadows cast immediately ventral to each ridge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible first dorsal fin contains a sparse distribution of high-luminance blobs, primarily located along the anterior margin and central surface of the fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Cluster of five remora-like commensals characterized by elongated high-luminance profiles positioned ventrally to the pectoral fin.
